gates.reason: Inspected untrusted shell-command parsing, secret-sensitive classification, permission-rule matching, and evidence handling; transcript content is parsed but never executed, written to disk, or sent externally.

Checked command classification, certainty scoring, prompt-friction arithmetic, deterministic ordering, conservative handling of dynamic shell input, and structured evidenceRef provenance; no reproducible incorrect claim or arithmetic defect survived review.
Risky-action evidence lookup repeatedly performs linear scans of timelines and timeline entries for each detected action, producing quadratic ingest/assembly behavior on large histories.
Inspected its filesystem writes and cleanup: writes use fixed fixture basenames beneath a newly created temporary-directory path and do not incorporate untrusted path components.
The tests reproducibly check parser counts, verification-section detection, byte-cap behavior, clustering totals, percentage ordering, valid assignments, and determinism using explicit fixtures.
This is bounded unit-test code with small fixtures and is not shipped or executed on a production hot path.

findings.title: Per-action evidence resolution rescans all timelines and entries
findings.what: detectRiskyActions invokes evidenceRefForToolCall for every detected action. Each invocation linearly searches the complete timelines array and then scans the selected timeline's entries, potentially twice. With many sessions or many risky calls in one session, evidence assembly grows as O(actions×sessions + actions×entries) instead of approximately linear input size.
findings.fix: Build sessionId-to-timeline and per-timeline toolUseId/fallback-key indexes once at the start of detectRiskyActions, then resolve each action's evidence through those indexes.
findings.acceptance: Add a synthetic scale test with many sessions and multiple risky calls per session that instruments or benchmarks evidence resolution; assert timelines and entries are indexed once and lookup work grows approximately linearly when the corpus size doubles, while returned evidenceRef values remain unchanged.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read both call sites and the helper at baseline. The helper performs Array.find/findIndex scans on every call, there is no memoization or prebuilt index in detectRiskyActions, and both precomputed and live-detection branches invoke it.
